scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start --workspace=echo_backend
scripts.build:docker: npm run build && docker rm -f echo && docker build -t echo .
scripts.start:docker: npm run build:docker && docker run --name echo -p 4000:4000 -e SERVER_NAME="Echo" -e SERVER_URL="https://localhost:4000" -e TLS_CERT_PATH=/certs/localhost-cert.pem -e TLS_KEY_PATH=/certs/localhost-key.pem -v ./test_logs:/watched_logs -v ./data:/app/data -v ./certs:/certs:ro echo
scripts.deploy:server: npm run build && docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t ghcr.io/br0nie5/echo:latest . --push
